title: Relative stability of different conformations and pathways of ligand escape in LIV-binding protein: A molecular dynamics simulation study
one_liner_zh: 该研究用MD和metadynamics模拟LIV结合蛋白的配体逃逸路径，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但缺乏TF-DNA体系关联。
abstract: Periplasmic binding proteins (PBPs) are a large family of receptors and transporters, present in gram-negative bacteria, which play a pivotal role in transport, chemotaxis and quorum sensing. These class of proteins have a distinct two domain architecture that undergo large conformational transitions through a hinge motion. In particular, Leucine-Isoleucine-Valine (LIV) binding protein can sense these specific side chains and undergoes a transition from a open to a closed conformation which is traditionally viewed as ligand induced conformational change. Here, atomistic molecular dynamics simulations and well-tempered metadynamics simulations are used to understand the role of ligand (namely, Isoleucine) in the conformational transition/selection of the LIV-binding protein. Furthermore, the pathway, energetics, and sequence of events during ligand escape/unbinding are unveiled from a microscopic perspective. Two distinct ligand binding pathways are identified: (i) domain separation followed by ligand escape, and (ii) ligand escape either followed by or synchronous with domain separation. The former is found to be energetically more favorable. Water is found to play an important role in the ligand unbinding process as well as providing stability to the closed conformation in the absence of the ligand, by forming bridging hydrogen bonds between two domains.
abstract_zh: 周质结合蛋白（Periplasmic binding proteins, PBPs）是一类存在于革兰氏阴性菌中的大型受体和转运蛋白家族，在转运、趋化性和群体感应中发挥关键作用。这类蛋白质具有独特的双结构域架构，通过铰链运动发生大的构象转变。特别是，亮氨酸-异亮氨酸-缬氨酸（Leucine-Isoleucine-Valine, LIV）结合蛋白能感知这些特定侧链，并从开放构象转变为闭合构象，这传统上被视为配体诱导的构象变化。本研究采用原子级分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和温和回火元动力学（well-tempered metadynamics）模拟，以理解配体（即异亮氨酸）在LIV结合蛋白构象转变/选择中的作用。此外，从微观视角揭示了配体逃逸/解绑过程中的路径、能量学及事件顺序。识别出两种不同的配体结合路径：（i）结构域分离后配体逃逸，和（ii）配体逃逸先于或与结构域分离同步发生。前者在能量上更为有利。研究发现，水在配体解绑过程中发挥重要作用，并在无配体情况下通过形成两个结构域间的桥接氢键，为闭合构象提供稳定性。
